extracted.name: Carrot and orange smoothie
extracted.description: Start your day with a vibrant orange and carrot smoothie for breakfast. With added oats and ginger, it will give you vitamin C and count towards your 5-a-day
ingredient_lines: 2 medium carrots peeled and roughly chopped or grated depending on your blender
instruction_lines: Tip all the ingredients into a blender or smoothie maker and blitz until smooth, adding 150ml water if it’s too thick – alter the consistency to your liking.
